planning_notes: The request for 5 HARD targets was fulfilled by selecting 5 distinct concepts from the 7 available and assigning each a unique, high-cognitive-load pedagogical facet. To ensure non-redundancy and high difficulty, I prioritized facets that require synthesis, error diagnosis, and boundary analysis rather than simple recall. Specifically: 1) 'Binary Search Partitioning Strategy' is assessed via MISCONCEPTION_TARGETING to test deep understanding of the partition invariant. 2) 'Cross-Array Comparison Conditions' is assessed via ERROR_DIAGNOSIS to identify subtle logic flaws in comparison operators. 3) 'Median Calculation Logic' is assessed via BOUNDARY_EDGE_CASE to handle odd/even length nuances and integer division traps. 4) 'Pointer Adjustment and Search Direction' is assessed via OUTPUT_PREDICTION requiring step-by-step tracing of a complex, non-trivial input. 5) 'Index and Pointer Management' is assessed via OFF_BY_ONE_ANALYSIS to test precise boundary handling in loop conditions and index updates.
